skills.name: HP Fortify
skills.description: High intensity exercise. Good effects on surrounding allies.  *Cancels continuous damage  *Skill Resistance +30% (7 sec) *HP x 40% Area Recovery (per sec) (7 sec)

skills.name: Double Speed
skills.description: Puts 2 paddles together and attacks enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *Enemy Evade Rate -50% (7 sec) *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -50% (7 sec) *ATK x 3600% Area Damage

abilities.name: Caffeine
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability won't fall asleep in advent stages  with the Deep Sleep obstacle effect.

abilities.name: Deploy: Assassination
abilities.description: Has a set chance of making a Reaper appear, killing 1 enemy Ranger instantly when Rangers deploy.　  - Activates only in PVP and Guild Battles. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - Abilities with the same effect will not activate again for 3 seconds. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
